Linked to posture/position.path: Sleep, position, back, on, with hand, over the head
Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to lie on your back with one hand stretched over your head.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं पीठ के बल लेटकर सोता/सोती हूँ और हाथ सिर के ऊपर रखता/रखती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main peeth ke bal letkar sota/soti hun aur hath sir ke upar rakhta/rakhti hun.

Linked to posture/position.path: Sleep, position, back, on, with head low
Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to lie on your back with your head held low.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं पीठ के बल लेटकर सोता/सोती हूँ और सिर नीचे की तरफ झुका रहता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main peeth ke bal letkar sota/soti hun aur sir neeche ki taraf jhuka rehta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you keep changing your position frequently.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं रात को बार-बार करवट बदलता/बदलती रहता/रहती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main raat ko bar-bar karavat badalta/badlati rahta/rahti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.path: Sleep, position, curled up like a dog
Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you curl up tightly like a dog.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं सोते समय कुत्ते की तरह सिकुड़कर गोल होकर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main sote samay kutte ki tarah sikudkar gol hokar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you have a particular way of positioning your head.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सोते समय मेरे सिर की स्थिति से जुड़ी सामान्य समस्या रहती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Sote samay mere sir ki sthiti se judi samanya samasya rahti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to tilt your head forward onto your chest.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं सोते समय सिर को आगे की तरफ झुकाकर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main sote samay sir ko aage ki taraf jhukakkar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to tilt your head back.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं सोते समय सिर को पीछे की तरफ झुकाकर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main sote samay sir ko piche ki taraf jhukakkar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to keep your head low.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं सोते समय सिर नीचे की तरफ रखकर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main sote samay sir neeche ki taraf rakhkar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.path: Sleep, position, head, to one side
Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to turn your head to one side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं सोते समय सिर एक तरफ को झुकाकर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main sote samay sir ek taraf ko jhukakkar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you end up in a kneeling position.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं सोते समय घुटनों के बल झुककर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main sote samay ghutnon ke bal jhukkar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you have a particular way of positioning your knees.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सोते समय मेरे घुटनों की स्थिति से जुड़ी सामान्य समस्या रहती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Sote samay mere ghutnon ki sthiti se judi samanya samasya rahti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to sleep with your knees bent up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं सोते समय घुटने मोड़कर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main sote samay ghutne modkar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.path: Sleep, position, knees, on the, with face forced into pillow
Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to kneel with your face pushed down into the pillow.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं घुटनों के बल होकर सोता/सोती हूँ और मुँह तकिए में धँसा रहता है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main ghutnon ke bal hokar sota/soti hoon aur munh takiye mein dhansa rahta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you have a particular way of positioning your arms or legs.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सोते समय मेरे हाथ-पैरों की स्थिति से जुड़ी सामान्य समस्या रहती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Sote samay mere hath-pairon ki sthiti se judi samanya samasya rahti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to lie with your arms or legs crossed over each other.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं सोते समय हाथ-पैर एक-दूसरे पर चढ़ाकर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main sote samay hath-pair ek-dusre par chadhakkar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to draw your arms and legs up toward your body.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं सोते समय हाथ-पैर सिकोड़कर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main sote samay hath-pair sikodrkar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to spread your arms and legs wide apart.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं सोते समय हाथ-पैर फैलाकर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main sote samay hath-pair failakkar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to stretch your arms and legs out straight.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं सोते समय हाथ-पैर सीधे तानकर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main sote samay hath-pair sidhe tankar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.path: Sleep, position, limbs, stretched out, the other drawn up
Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to stretch one arm or leg out straight while drawing the other one up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं सोते समय एक हाथ-पैर सीधा तानकर और दूसरा सिकोड़कर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main sote samay ek hath-pair sidha tankar aur dusra sikodrkar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.path: Sleep, position, limbs, uncovered, inclined to have
Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you feel an urge to keep your arms or legs uncovered.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं सोते समय हाथ-पैर को खुला (बिना ढके) रखना चाहता/चाहती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main sote samay hath-pair ko khula (bina dhke) rakhna chahta/chahti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.en: You find it impossible to lie down to sleep.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मुझे लेटकर सोना बिल्कुल नहीं हो पाता।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Mujhe letkar sona bilkul nahi ho pata.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to lie on your side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सोते समय करवट लेकर सोने की स्थिति से जुड़ी सामान्य समस्या रहती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Sote samay karavat lekar sone ki sthiti se judi samanya samasya rahti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: You find it impossible to sleep lying on your side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मुझे करवट लेकर सोना बिल्कुल नहीं हो पाता।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Mujhe karavat lekar sona bilkul nahi ho pata.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to lie on your left side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं बाईं करवट लेकर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main bayin karavat lekar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.en: You find it impossible to sleep lying on your left side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मुझे बाईं करवट लेकर सोना बिल्कुल नहीं हो पाता।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Mujhe bayin karavat lekar sona bilkul nahi ho pata.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to lie on your side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं करवट लेकर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main karavat lekar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.en: During sleep, you tend to lie on your right side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं दाईं करवट लेकर सोता/सोती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main dayin karavat lekar sota/soti hoon.

Linked to posture/position.en: You find it impossible to sleep lying on your right side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मुझे दाईं करवट लेकर सोना बिल्कुल नहीं हो पाता।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Mujhe dayin karavat lekar sona bilkul nahi ho pata.

Linked to posture/position.en: You tend to fall asleep or sleep while sitting up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: मैं बैठे-बैठे ही सो जाता/जाती हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Main baithe-baithe hi so jata/jati hoon.

Linked to time of day.en: You sleep for much longer than usual around midday.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर के समय मेरी नींद बहुत ज़्यादा और लंबी हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ke samay meri nind bahut zyada aur lambi ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad meri nind bechaain rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay meri neend becain rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko meri neend becain rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, restless, night, 3 a.m. to 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 3 बजे से 5 बजे के बीच मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 3 baje se 5 baje ke beech meri neend becain rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled after 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 2 बजे के बाद मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 2 baje ke baad meri neend becain rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled after 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 3 बजे के बाद मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 3 baje ke baad meri neend becain rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled after 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 4 बजे के बाद मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 4 baje ke baad meri neend becain rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled at night just before a sudden attack or episode comes on.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को दर्द के दौरे आने से पहले मेरी नींद बेचैन हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko dard ke daure aane se pehle meri neend becain ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled around midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात को मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ko meri neend becain rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ke baad meri neend becain rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, restless, night, midnight, after, until 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled from after midnight until around 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद 3 बजे तक मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ke baad 3 baje tak meri neend becain rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled before midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle meri neend becain rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, restless, night, midnight, until 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled from midnight until around 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से 2 बजे तक मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se 2 baje tak meri neend becain rahti hai.

General.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled when you have the chills.
General.hi: ठंड लगने पर मेरी नींद बेचैन हो जाती है।
General.roman: Thandi lagne par meri nind bechaain ho jati hai.

General.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled after a bout of chills.
General.hi: ठंड लगने के बाद मेरी नींद बेचैन हो जाती है।
General.roman: Thandi lagne ke baad meri nind bechaain ho jati hai.

General.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled before a bout of chills comes on.
General.hi: ठंड लगने से पहले मेरी नींद बेचैन हो जाती है।
General.roman: Thandi lagne se pehle meri nind bechaain ho jati hai.

General.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled because of disturbing dreams.
General.hi: बुरे सपनों की वजह से मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
General.roman: Bure sapnon ki wajah se meri nind bechaain rahti hai.

General.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled because your body itself feels physically restless and unable to keep still.
General.hi: शरीर में शारीरिक बेचैनी की वजह से नींद ठीक नहीं आती।
General.roman: Sharir mein sharirik becainni ki wajah se neend theek nahi aati.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Sleep, restless, coldness of body, from
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled because your body feels cold.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: शरीर ठंडा पड़ने पर मेरी नींद बेचैन हो जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Sharir thanda padne par meri nind bechaain ho jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद मेरी नींद बेचैन हो जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane ke baad meri nind bechaain ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled after a sexual release.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: स्वप्नदोष के बाद मेरी नींद बेचैन हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Swapndosh ke baad meri nind bechaain ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Sleep, restless, lying on left side
Linked to posture/position.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled when you lie on your left side.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बाईं करवट लेटने पर मेरी नींद बेचैन हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Bayin karavat letne par meri nind bechaain ho jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Your sleep is restless around the time of your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दिनों में मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahvari ke dinon mein meri nind bechaain rahti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled after your menstrual period ends.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी खत्म होने के बाद मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari khatm hone ke baad meri neend becain rahti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled before your menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari aane se pehle meri neend becain rahti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled during your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran meri neend becain rahti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled because of aching or pain in your arms or legs.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: हाथ-पैरों में दर्द की वजह से मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Hath-pairon mein dard ki wajah se meri neend becain rahti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: Your sleep is restless and unsettled because your arms or legs keep twitching.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: हाथ-पैरों में झटके लगने की वजह से मेरी नींद बेचैन रहती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Hath-pairon mein jhatke lagne ki wajah se meri neend becain rahti hai.

General.en: You are in a half-conscious drowsy state but can still hear everything going on around you.
General.hi: मेरी नींद आधी-अधूरी रहती है और इस हालत में मुझे आसपास की सब बातें सुनाई देती रहती हैं।
General.roman: Meri neend aadhi-adhuri rahti hai aur is halat mein mujhe aaspas ki sab batein sunai deti rahti hain.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel very drowsy and have a strong urge to sleep in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद मुझे बहुत नींद आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad mujhe bahut neend aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleepiness, afternoon, 1 p.m. to 2 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You feel very drowsy and have a strong urge to sleep between 1 p.m. and 2 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर 1 बजे से 2 बजे के बीच मुझे बहुत नींद आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar 1 baje se 2 baje ke beech mujhe bahut neend aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel very drowsy and have a strong urge to sleep at around 2 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर 2 बजे मुझे बहुत नींद आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar 2 baje mujhe bahut neend aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleepiness, afternoon, 2 p.m. to 3 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You feel very drowsy and have a strong urge to sleep between 2 p.m. and 3 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर 2 बजे से 3 बजे के बीच मुझे बहुत नींद आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar 2 baje se 3 baje ke beech mujhe bahut neend aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleepiness, afternoon, 2 p.m. to 4 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You feel very drowsy and have a strong urge to sleep between 2 p.m. and 4 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर 2 बजे से 4 बजे के बीच मुझे बहुत नींद आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar 2 baje se 4 baje ke beech mujhe bahut neend aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleepiness, afternoon, 2 p.m. to 5 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You feel very drowsy and have a strong urge to sleep between 2 p.m. and 5 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर 2 बजे से शाम 5 बजे के बीच मुझे बहुत नींद आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar 2 baje se sham 5 baje ke beech mujhe bahut neend aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel very drowsy and have a strong urge to sleep at around 2:30 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर साढ़े 2 बजे मुझे बहुत नींद आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar sadhe 2 baje mujhe bahut neend aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel very drowsy and have a strong urge to sleep at around 3 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर 3 बजे मुझे बहुत नींद आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar 3 baje mujhe bahut neend aati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleepiness, afternoon, 3 p.m. to 7 p.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You feel very drowsy and have a strong urge to sleep between 3 p.m. and 7 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर 3 बजे से शाम 7 बजे के बीच मुझे बहुत नींद आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar 3 baje se sham 7 baje ke beech mujhe bahut neend aati hai.

Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko gyarah baje ke baad se raat ek baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, after 11 p.m., until, 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep from 11 p.m. until 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 11 बजे के बाद से रात 2 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko gyarah baje ke baad se raat do baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot get back to sleep after 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 2 बजे के बाद नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko do baje ke baad neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot get back to sleep after 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 3 बजे के बाद नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko teen baje ke baad neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot get back to sleep after 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 4 बजे के बाद नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko char baje ke baad neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot get back to sleep after 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 5 बजे के बाद नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko paanch baje ke baad neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, after, 1 a.m. or 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep after 1 a.m. or 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 1 या 2 बजे के बाद नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko ek ya do baje ke baad neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, after, 2 a.m. or 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep after 2 a.m. or 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 2 या 3 बजे के बाद नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko do ya teen baje ke baad neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep after about 2:30 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को साढ़े दो बजे के बाद नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko saadhe do baje ke baad neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep at 1 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को ठीक 1 बजे नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko theek ek baje neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, first part of
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep during the first part of the night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात के शुरुआती हिस्से में नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ke shuruaati hisse mein neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep during the night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को (किसी कारण से) नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, from 1 a.m. to 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep from 1 a.m. to 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 1 बजे से 2 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 1 baje se 2 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, from, 1 a.m. to 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep from 1 a.m. to 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 1 बजे से 4 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 1 baje se 4 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, from, 1 a.m., to 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep from 1 a.m. to 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 1 बजे से सुबह 5 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 1 baje se subah 5 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, from, 2 a.m. to 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep from 2 a.m. to 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 2 बजे से 4 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 2 baje se 4 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, from, 2 a.m., to 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep from 2 a.m. to 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 2 बजे से सुबह 5 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 2 baje se subah 5 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, from, 3 a.m. to 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep from 3 a.m. to 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 3 बजे से 4 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 3 baje se 4 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, from, 3 a.m., to 5 a.m., from heat
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep from 3 a.m. to 5 a.m. because of feeling too hot.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 3 बजे से सुबह 5 बजे तक गर्मी की वजह से नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 3 baje se subah 5 baje tak garmi ki wajah se neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep around midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात को नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ko neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ke baad neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep before midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, midnight, before, until
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep before midnight and it continues past midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले से लेकर (किसी समय) तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle se lekar kisi samay tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, midnight, before, until 1 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep before midnight and it lasts until 1 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले से लेकर रात 1 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle se lekar raat 1 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, midnight, before, until, 1 a.m. or 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep before midnight and it lasts until 1 a.m. or 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले से लेकर रात 1 या 2 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle se lekar raat 1 ya 2 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, midnight, before, until, 1-30 a.m. to 2-30 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep before midnight and it lasts from about 1:30 a.m. to 2:30 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले से लेकर डेढ़ बजे से ढाई बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle se lekar dedh baje se dhai baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, midnight, before, until, 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep before midnight and it lasts until 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले से लेकर रात 2 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle se lekar raat 2 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, midnight, before, until, 2 a.m. to 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep before midnight and it lasts until between 2 a.m. and 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले से लेकर रात 2 से 3 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle se lekar raat 2 se 3 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, midnight, before, until, 2 a.m., to 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep before midnight and it lasts until between 2 a.m. and 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले से लेकर रात 2 से 4 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle se lekar raat 2 se 4 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, midnight, before, until, 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep before midnight and it lasts until 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले से लेकर रात 3 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle se lekar raat 3 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, midnight, before, until, 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep before midnight and it lasts until 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले से लेकर रात 4 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle se lekar raat 4 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, midnight, before, until, 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep before midnight and it lasts until 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले से लेकर सुबह 5 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle se lekar subah 5 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, night, midnight, before, until, morning
Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep before midnight and it lasts all the way until morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात से पहले से लेकर सुबह होने तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle se lekar subah hone tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep until a certain point in the night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को (एक निश्चित समय) तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko (ek nischit samay) tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep until 1 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 1 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 1 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep until 11 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 11 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 11 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep until 3 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 3 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 3 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep until 5 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को सुबह 5 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko subah 5 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep until 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 2 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 2 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot sleep until 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को 4 बजे तक नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko 4 baje tak neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, retiring, after, but sleepy before
Linked to time of day.en: You feel sleepy beforehand but then cannot sleep once you have gone to bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: बिस्तर पर जाने के बाद नींद नहीं आती, जबकि पहले नींद आ रही थी।
Linked to time of day.roman: Bistar par jane ke baad nind nahi aati, jabki pehle nind aa rahi thi.

Linked to time of day.en: You cannot get back to sleep after waking during the night.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद खुल जाने के बाद दोबारा नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to time of day.roman: Neend khul jane ke baad dobara neend nahi aati.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: You cannot sleep after getting angry.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: गुस्सा होने के बाद नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Gussa hone ke baad neend nahi aati.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: You cannot sleep because of grief or sorrow.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: दुख या शोक की वजह से नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Dukh ya shok ki wajah se nind nahi aati.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: You cannot sleep because you are feeling homesick.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: घर की याद (होमसिकनेस) की वजह से नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Ghar ki yaad ki wajah se nind nahi aati.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: You cannot sleep and feel emotionally overwrought or hysterical.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: हिस्टीरिया (अत्यधिक भावनात्मक उथल-पुथल) की वजह से नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Hysteria ki wajah se nind nahi aati.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: You cannot sleep because of vivid imaginary images or daydream-like visions running through your mind.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: मन में अजीब-अजीब कल्पनाएँ और भ्रम आने की वजह से नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Man mein ajeeb-ajeeb kalpnayein aur bhram aane ki wajah se nind nahi aati.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: You cannot sleep because you feel excessively joyful or elated.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: अत्यधिक खुशी की वजह से नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Atyadhik khushi ki wajah se nind nahi aati.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: You cannot sleep and feel wildly agitated or out of control.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: पागलपन जैसी मानसिक अवस्था में नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Pagalpan jaisi mansik avasta mein nind nahi aati.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: You cannot sleep after feeling humiliated or deeply embarrassed.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: किसी बात से बेइज्जती या अपमान महसूस होने के बाद नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Kisi baat se beizzati ya apman mehsoos hone ke baad neend nahi aati.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: You cannot sleep because of feeling sad.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: उदासी की वजह से नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Udasi ki wajah se nind nahi aati.

Linked to mood/emotion.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, thoughts activity of mind, from
Linked to mood/emotion.en: You cannot sleep because your mind is too active with thoughts.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: मन में विचारों की उथल-पुथल की वजह से नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Man mein vicharon ki uthal-puthal ki wajah se nind nahi aati.

Linked to mood/emotion.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, thoughts, same idea always repeated
Linked to mood/emotion.en: You cannot sleep because the same thought or idea keeps repeating in your mind.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: एक ही विचार बार-बार मन में घूमता रहता है जिससे नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Ek hi vichar baar-baar man mein ghumta rehta hai jisse nind nahi aati.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: You cannot sleep after feeling angry or upset about something.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: किसी बात पर गुस्सा या खीझ होने के बाद नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Kisi baat par gussa ya khiz hone ke baad nind nahi aati.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: You cannot sleep because of vivid visions appearing before you.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: मन में तरह-तरह के दृश्य या छवियाँ आने की वजह से नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Man mein tarah-tarah ke drishya ya chhaviyan aane ki wajah se neend nahi aati.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: You cannot sleep because you feel unusually lively, energetic, or mentally bright.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: मन बहुत ज़्यादा चुस्त और सक्रिय रहने की वजह से नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Man bahut zyada chust aur sakriya rehne ki wajah se neend nahi aati.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: You cannot sleep because of anxiety or worry.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: चिंता या घबराहट की वजह से नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Chinta ya ghabrahat ki wajah se neend nahi aati.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: You cannot sleep because you are too excited or worked up.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: अत्यधिक उत्तेजना या जोश की वजह से नींद नहीं आती।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Atyadhik uttejana ya josh ki wajah se nind nahi aati.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, burning in the veins
Sensation / feel of the area.en: You cannot sleep because of a burning sensation in your veins or blood vessels.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: नसों में जलन होने के कारण नींद नहीं आती।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Nason mein jalan hone ke kaaran neend nahi aati.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: You cannot sleep because of a drawing or pulling sensation in your legs.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: टाँगों में खिंचाव होने की वजह से नींद नहीं आती।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Tangon mein khinchav hone ki wajah se neend nahi aati.

Triggered by specific situations.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, child must be carried
Triggered by specific situations.en: A child cannot sleep unless they are being carried and held.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: बच्चे को गोद में उठाकर घुमाने पर ही वो सो पाता है, लिटाने पर जाग जाता है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Bachche ko god mein uthkar ghumane par hi wo so pata hai, litane par jag jata hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You cannot sleep after sexual intercourse.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: संभोग के बाद नींद नहीं आती।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Sambhog ke baad neend nahi aati.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You cannot sleep after having a conversation or talking with someone.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: किसी से लंबी बातचीत के बाद नींद नहीं आती।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Kisi se lambi baatchit ke baad neend nahi aati.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You cannot sleep when the room is dark.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: अंधेरे कमरे में नींद नहीं आती।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Andhere kamre mein neend nahi aati.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You cannot sleep when you are going through severe alcohol withdrawal or delirium from stopping drinking.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: शराब के अत्यधिक सेवन से होने वाली मानसिक उत्तेजना (प्रलाप) में नींद नहीं आती।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Sharab ke atyadhik sevan se hone wali mansik uttejna (pralap) mein neend nahi aati.

Triggered by specific situations.path: Sleep, sleeplessness, disturbed from sleep, if
Triggered by specific situations.en: Once you are woken up from sleep you cannot fall back to sleep again.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: एक बार नींद टूट जाए तो दोबारा नींद नहीं आती।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Ek baar neend tut jaye to dobara neend nahi aati.

Linked to time of day.en: You wake up at 2 a.m. because you feel overheated.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 2 बजे गर्मी लगने की वजह से नींद खुल जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat 2 baje garmi lagne ki wajah se neend khul jati hai.

Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात को नींद खुल जाती है।

Linked to time of day.en: You wake up after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद नींद खुल जाती है।

Linked to time of day.en: You wake up before midnight.

Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat se pehle neend khul jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You wake up after midnight because of a dream.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद सपना आने पर नींद खुल जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ke baad sapna aane par neend khul jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You tend to wake up in the early morning hours as morning approaches.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह होने की तरफ नींद खुल जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah hone ki taraf neend khul jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You wake up at the same time every night without fail.
Linked to time of day.hi: हर रात एक ही तय समय पर नींद खुल जाती है।

Linked to time of day.en: You wake up suddenly and abruptly at 2 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात 2 बजे नींद अचानक खुल जाती है।

Triggered by specific situations.hi: ठंड लगने से नींद खुल जाती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Thandi lagne se nind khul jati hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You wake up because of a cough.

Triggered by specific situations.roman: Khansi ki wajah se nind khul jati hai.

Triggered by specific situations.roman: Sapne aane ki wajah se nind khul jati hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You wake up repeatedly because of dreams.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You wake up because you feel overheated.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You wake up because you feel hungry.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: भूख लगने की वजह से नींद खुल जाती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Bhookh lagne ki wajah se neend khul jati hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You wake up because you feel nauseated.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: जी मिचलाने की वजह से नींद खुल जाती है।

Triggered by specific situations.en: You wake up when there is noise.

Triggered by specific situations.en: Even a very slight noise wakes you up.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: हल्की-सी आवाज़ से भी नींद खुल जाती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Halki-si aawaz se bhi neend khul jati hai.

Triggered by specific situations.path: Sleep, waking, noise, rattling of paper
Triggered by specific situations.en: The rustling or rattling of paper is enough to wake you up.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: कागज़ की सरसराहट की आवाज़ से नींद खुल जाती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Kagaz ki sarsarahat ki aawaz se neend khul jati hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You wake up because of pain.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: दर्द की वजह से नींद खुल जाती है।

Triggered by specific situations.en: You wake up because of sweating.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: पसीना आने की वजह से नींद खुल जाती है।

Triggered by specific situations.path: Sleep, waking, shocks through the body, while
Triggered by specific situations.en: You wake up because of sudden jolt-like shocks that pass through your body.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: सोते समय शरीर में झटके लगते हैं और नींद खुल जाती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Sote samay sharir mein jhatke lagte hain aur neend khul jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: You wake up with a cough.

Comes with other symptoms.en: You wake up with a feeling of numbness in your body.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: नींद खुलने पर शरीर के किसी हिस्से में सुन्नपन होता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Neend khulne par sharir ke kisi hisse mein sunnapan hota hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: You wake up with a sensation of your heart pounding or racing.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: दिल की धड़कन तेज़ होने से नींद खुल जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Dil ki dhadkan tez hone se neend khul jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Sleep, waking, cough, from, menses, during
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You wake up during your menstrual period because of a cough.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान खांसी की वजह से नींद खुल जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran khansi ki wajah se nind khul jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Your sleep is disturbed or you wake up around the time of your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान नींद खुल जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran neend khul jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You wake up in the night before your menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी शुरू होने से पहले नींद खुल जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari shuru hone se pehle neend khul jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Your sleep gets worse and you wake up during your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान नींद खुलने की समस्या और बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran neend khulne ki samasya aur badh jati hai.

General.en: Once you wake up, it is hard to fall back asleep.
General.hi: नींद खुलने के बाद दोबारा सोना बहुत मुश्किल हो जाता है।
General.roman: Nind khulne ke baad dobara sona bahut mushkil ho jata hai.

General.en: You wake up earlier than you intended or need to.
General.hi: नींद बहुत जल्दी खुल जाती है।
General.roman: Nind bahut jaldi khul jati hai.

General.en: You wake up repeatedly throughout the night.
General.hi: रात में बार-बार नींद खुलती रहती है।
General.roman: Rat mein bar-bar nind khulti rahti hai.

General.en: You find it impossible to wake up properly or fully rouse yourself from sleep.
General.hi: रात में बिल्कुल नींद नहीं आती।
General.roman: Raat mein bilkul neend nahi aati.

General.en: You wake up later than usual or much later than you intended.
General.hi: नींद देर से खुलती है।
General.roman: Neend der se khulti hai.

General.en: You wake up suddenly and abruptly.
General.hi: नींद अचानक खुल जाती है।
General.roman: Neend achanak khul jati hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: You wake up from sleep with a sudden feeling of fright.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: डर की वजह से नींद खुल जाती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Dar ki wajah se nind khul jati hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: You wake up as if startled by a fright, even though nothing frightening happened.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: नींद खुलती है जैसे किसी बात से डर गए हों।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Nind khulti hai jaise kisi baat se dar gaye hon.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: You wake up and find yourself crying or in tears.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: नींद खुलने पर रोना आ जाता है।

Temperature sensation.hi: शरीर में गर्मी होने से नींद खुल जाती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Sharir mein garmi hone se nind khul jati hai.

Linked to time of day.hi: रात को जम्हाई आती है।

Linked to time of day.en: You yawn a lot around noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर के समय जम्हाई आती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ke samay jumhai aati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Yawning that occurs during sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद में भी जम्हाई आती है।

Linked to time of day.en: Intense, spasmodic yawning that happens in the morning.

Linked to posture/position.en: Yawning that comes on while sitting down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठे-बैठे जम्हाई आती है।

Triggered by specific actions.en: You yawn a lot after going for a walk in the afternoon.

Triggered by specific actions.en: You yawn when you cough.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Sleep, yawning, frequent, evening, reading, after
Triggered by specific actions.en: You yawn very frequently in the evening after reading.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: शाम को पढ़ने के बाद बार-बार जम्हाई आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sham ko padhne ke baad bar-bar jamhai aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Sleep, yawning, frequent, evening, riding in a carriage
Triggered by specific actions.en: You yawn very frequently in the evening while riding in a vehicle.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: शाम को गाड़ी में बैठकर सफर करते समय बार-बार जम्हाई आती है।

Triggered by specific actions.path: Sleep, yawning, morning, walking in open air

Triggered by specific actions.hi: सुबह खुली हवा में चलते समय जम्हाई आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Subah khuli hawa mein chaalte samay jumhai aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: You yawn a lot around noon after going for a walk.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: दोपहर को चलने के बाद जम्हाई आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Dopahar ko chalne ke baad jumhai aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Yawning that is brought on by reading.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पढ़ते समय जम्हाई आती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Padhte samay jumhai aati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Yawning that is brought on by reading aloud.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: ज़ोर से पढ़ते समय जम्हाई आती है।

Triggered by specific actions.en: Yawning that happens while reading silently.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पढ़ते-पढ़ते जम्हाई आने लगती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Padhte-padhte jumhai aane lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.roman: Chalte-chalte jumhai aane lagti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sharab pine ke baad jumhai kam ho jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: You yawn when you feel a chill coming on.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड लगने (कँपकँपी) के साथ जम्हाई आती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi lagne kapkapi ke saath jambhai aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: You yawn just before a bout of chills starts.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड लगने (कँपकँपी) से पहले जम्हाई आती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi lagne kapkapi se pehle jambhai aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Sleep, yawning, chill, before, mouth remains open for a long time
Comes with other symptoms.en: Just before a chill, you yawn repeatedly and your mouth stays open for a long time.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड लगने से पहले जम्हाई आती है और मुँह काफी देर तक खुला रह जाता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi lagne se pehle jambhai aati hai aur munh kaafi der tak khula reh jata hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: You yawn during a bout of chills.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंड लगने (कँपकँपी) के दौरान जम्हाई आती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi lagne kapkapi ke dauran jambhai aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: You yawn and also feel chilly at the same time.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: ठंडक महसूस होने के साथ-साथ जम्हाई भी आती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Thandi mahsoos hone ke saath-saath jhambai bhi aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: You yawn and also feel a general sense of coldness at the same time.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: शरीर में ठंडापन महसूस होने के साथ जम्हाई आती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sharir mein thandapan mahsoos hone ke saath jhambai aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: You yawn alongside coughing.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: खांसते समय जम्हाई आती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Khanste samay jhambai aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: You yawn when you are short of breath or having difficulty breathing.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: सांस लेने में तकलीफ होने के साथ जम्हाई आती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sans lene mein taklif hone ke saath jhambai aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: You yawn a lot when you feel feverish or hot.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: बुखार या शरीर में गर्मी होने के दौरान जम्हाई आती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Bukhar ya sharir mein garmi hone ke dauran jamhai aati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Sleep, yawning, laughter, involuntary, followed by
Comes with other symptoms.en: After yawning, you break into involuntary laughter.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: जम्हाई आने के बाद अपने आप हँसी भी आ जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Jamhai aane ke baad apne aap hansi bhi aa jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: Yawning that comes with a tight or heavy feeling in the chest.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: जम्हाई के साथ सीने पर दबाव या भारीपन महसूस होता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Jumhai ke saath sine par dabaav ya bharipan mehsus hota hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: Yawning that is followed by or accompanied by a shudder or shiver.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: जम्हाई के साथ कँपकँपी या सिहरन होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Jumhai ke saath kampkampi ya sihran hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: Yawning that comes along with dizziness.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: जम्हाई के साथ चक्कर भी आते हैं।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Jumhai ke sath chakkar bhi aate hain.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You yawn after a bout of coughing.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: खांसी के बाद जम्हाई आती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Khansi ke baad jhambai aati hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You yawn a lot after a bout of diarrhea.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: दस्त होने के बाद जम्हाई आती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Dast hone ke baad jhambai aati hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You yawn after drinking cold water.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: ठंडा पानी पीने से जम्हाई आती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Thanda pani pine se jhambai aati hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: You yawn when you are listening to other people talking.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: किसी की बात सुनते समय जम्हाई आती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Kisi ki baat sunte samay jamhai aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Raat ka khana khane ke baad jhambai aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रात का खाना खाने के बाद जम्हाई आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Raat ka khana khane ke baad jumhai aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रात का खाना खाने से पहले जम्हाई आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Raat ka khana khane se pehle jumhai aati hai.

General.en: You yawn very frequently throughout the day.
General.hi: बार-बार जम्हाई आती रहती है।
General.roman: Bar-bar jamhai aati rahti hai.

General.en: Yawning that happens even when you do not feel sleepy.
General.hi: जम्हाई आती है पर नींद बिल्कुल नहीं आती।
General.roman: Jumhai aati hai par nind bilkul nahi aati.

General.en: Yawning that comes in intense, uncontrollable spasms.
General.hi: जम्हाई बड़े ज़ोर के झटकों में आती है, जैसे खिंचाव हो।
General.roman: Jumhai bade zor ke jhatkon mein aati hai, jaise khinchaav ho.

General.en: Yawning that is extremely forceful or violent.
General.hi: बहुत तेज़ और ज़ोरदार जम्हाई आती है।
General.roman: Bahut tez aur zordaar jumhai aati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Sleep, yawning, frequent, afternoon, menses, during
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You yawn very frequently in the afternoon during your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान दोपहर बाद बार-बार जम्हाई आती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahvari ke dauran dopahar bad bar-bar jamhai aati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Your yawning is connected to the time of your menstrual period in general.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के समय जम्हाई आती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahvari ke samay jamhai aati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You yawn a lot in the days before your menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले जम्हाई आती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahvari aane se pehle jamhai aati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You yawn a lot during your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान जम्हाई आती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran jumhai aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Sleep, yawning, fruitless efforts to yawn
Sensation / feel of the area.en: You try to yawn but cannot complete the yawn — it feels unsatisfying or impossible to finish.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: जम्हाई लेने की कोशिश करता/करती हूँ पर पूरी जम्हाई नहीं आती।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Jamhai lene ki koshish karta/karti hoon par puri jamhai nahi aati.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: You try to yawn but it never feels complete or satisfying.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: जम्हाई आने लगती है पर पूरी तरह आती नहीं, अधूरी रह जाती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Jamhai aane lagti hai par puri tarah aati nahi, adhuri reh jati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: Your yawning gets cut short or interrupted before it finishes.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: जम्हाई बीच में ही रुक जाती है, पूरी नहीं होती।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Jamhai beech mein hi ruk jati hai, puri nahi hoti.

Linked to bowel movement.en: Yawning that is related to having a bowel movement.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: शौच के दौरान जम्हाई आती है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Shauch ke dauran jumhai aati hai.

Linked to bowel movement.en: Yawning that comes on after a bowel movement.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: शौच के बाद जम्हाई आती है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Shauch ke baad jumhai aati hai.

Linked to bowel movement.en: Yawning that comes on just before a bowel movement.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: शौच से पहले जम्हाई आती है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Shauch se pehle jumhai aati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Yawning that is brought on or made worse by being in a warm bed.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म बिस्तर में लेटने पर जम्हाई आती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm bistar mein letne par jumhai aati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Yawning that is brought on or made worse by being in a warm room.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म कमरे में रहने पर जम्हाई आती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm kamre mein rahne par jumhai aati hai.
